name: dev
description: Standard dev workflow: planning → implement → check → done with researcher / implementer / checker roles

breadcrumb.planning: [Wf · planning · dev] 调研 + 拆 task items;加载 wf-brainstorm skill;完成后请用户确认转 implement
breadcrumb.implement: [Wf · implement · dev] 推进 task items(update_checklist 改 task.json);用 wf-before-dev 检查规范;完成后请用户确认转 check
breadcrumb.check: [Wf · check · dev] 校验 + 测试;checker 跑 review(加载 wf-check);完成后请用户确认转 done
breadcrumb.done: [Wf · done · dev] 触发 spec 沉淀 + task 归档(spec-distillation 在 Phase 3 落地)
